name: school_fees
summary: Fee structures, penalty rules, and configurable discount matrices
description: Admin-configurable fee setup for the school payment system: per-class/section fee structures with frequency and due day, dynamic daily/fixed/percent penalty rules, multi-sibling family annual discount thresholds, and the teacher's-child experience-to-discount matrix. All rates and thresholds are editable records, never hardcoded. Modification is restricted to the Manager/Director role.
author: Nexa
